exclusion_detail: Lead 5p needs its 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole 4p, which the text says was 'prepared according to the reported procedure [42]' (acid chloride / aroylamidoguanidine / water ring closure described only in general terms and with the scheme and text disagreeing on the solvent: DCM vs 1,4-dioxane); no procedure, quantities or characterisation for 4p or its precursors are in the bundle (the supplementary data link is a placeholder and no SI file exists). The aldehyde of the final multicomponent step is also never named as a reagent, only implied by the product name.

lead.label: 5p
lead.why: Abstract: 'The representative compound 5p exhibited remarkable fluorescence response with fluorescence quantum yields (QY) of 0.37 and inhibitory rate of 85.21 +/- 5.17% against SHP1PTP'; it is the compound taken to the ion-sensing and cell-imaging follow-up.

notes: The final step is explicit (aminotriazole + aromatic aldehyde + tert-butyl isocyanide, HClO4 cat., MeOH, rt; general procedure 4.2, yield 59% for 5p); the aldehyde for 5p would be 5-formylsalicylic acid by inference from the name. The whole series needs an aryl aminotriazole 4 made by citation, so no other compound qualifies. Document is an SSRN preprint / accepted manuscript.
